title: LootHighlighter
description: A lightweight client-side mod that adds a colorful glow to dropped items for better visibility and loot identification.
body:
LootHighlighter - Visual Loot Identification
LootHighlighter is a lightweight, client-side mod that adds a colored glow to items dropped on the ground, making them much easier to see in dark caves, water, or after intense combat.

💡 Main Features
Dynamic Outlines: Items on the ground emit a glow that helps you spot them from a distance.

Color Coding: Categorized colors allow you to identify what type of loot is on the ground before even picking it up.

No Lag: Built with optimized Mixins for zero impact on your game performance.

Server-Friendly: Since it's client-side, you can use it on any server without any issues!.

🎨 Color Guide
🔴 Red: All Swords and Tools (Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels, Shears).

🔵 Blue: All pieces of Armor.

🟡 Yellow: Rare consumables like Totems of Undying and Golden Apples.

🟣 Bright Purple: Obsidian and Crying Obsidian blocks.

🟢 Green: Ender Pearls.

⚪ White: Cobwebs.

✨ Default: Other items use their standard Minecraft rarity colors (e.g., Epic items glow Purple).

⚙️ Requirements
Minecraft: 1.21.4.

Loader: Fabric.

Dependency: Fabric API.
